.name: Filter my Steam wishlist
.note: Filter the current Steam wishlist by individual fields. To rank by current price, use sortBy=currentPrice with direction=asc or desc. Missing prices are unknown.
.description: Filter the current Steam wishlist by individual fields. To rank by current price, use sortBy=currentPrice with direction=asc or desc. Missing prices are unknown.
.parameters.1.description: Sort field. Defaults to name for the library and wishlist order for the wishlist.
.parameters.2.description: asc for ascending (default), desc for descending.
.parameters.3.description: Take this many results after sorting all matches. Omit to return every matching AppID.
.parameters.appid: AppID. Pass op and value per condition, or omit this parameter.
.parameters.name: Game title. Pass op and value per condition, or omit this parameter.
.parameters.addedAt: Date added. Pass op and value per condition, or omit this parameter.
.parameters.originalPrice: Original price. Pass op and value per condition, or omit this parameter.
.parameters.currentPrice: Current price. Pass op and value per condition, or omit this parameter.
.parameters.discounted: Discounted. Pass op and value per condition, or omit this parameter.
.parameters.discountPercent: Discount percentage. Pass op and value per condition, or omit this parameter.
